nodes.description: Germline nonsense and frameshift variants in FLG, most commonly R501X and 2282del4 in Europeans and population-specific alleles in Asia, truncate profilaggrin. Because the C-terminal region is required for processing, truncations anywhere in the repeat array abolish or sharply reduce filaggrin production, and with it the keratin filament binding of the filaggrin monomers. How much the clinical phenotype depends on lost keratin aggregation, as opposed to lost natural moisturizing factor, is debated: a filaggrin knockdown skin model showed no keratin extraction defect (PMID:20445547).
